territorial_scope.description: A California state statute applying to health facilities, clinics, physician offices and group practices within the State of California.

evidence.quote: Chapter 2.13 (commencing with Section 1339.75) is added to Division 2 of the Health and Safety Code

agora_applications: Medicine, life sciences and public health

summary.short: Adds Health and Safety Code §1339.75. Health facilities, clinics, physician offices and group practices that use generative AI to generate written or verbal patient communications about clinical information must include an AI disclaimer and instructions for reaching a human provider. Communications reviewed by a licensed provider are exempt.
summary.long: Section 1 adds Chapter 2.13 to Division 2 of the Health and Safety Code. Subdivision (a) applies to health facilities, clinics, physician offices and offices of group practices that use generative artificial intelligence to generate written or verbal patient communications pertaining to patient clinical information. Such communications must include a disclaimer that they were generated by generative AI, placed by medium: at the beginning for letters and emails, throughout for continuous online interactions and video, and at the start and end for audio. They must also give clear instructions on how a patient may contact a human health care provider or other appropriate person. Subdivision (b) exempts communications that a licensed or certified health care provider reads and reviews. Subdivision (c) defines terms including artificial intelligence, generative artificial intelligence, health care provider and patient clinical information, which excludes administrative matters such as scheduling and billing. Subdivision (d) makes violations by licensed health facilities and clinics subject to enforcement mechanisms in the Health and Safety Code chapters cited, and places physicians under the jurisdiction of the Medical Board of California or the Osteopathic Medical Board of California. The text states no effective date.

evidence.quote: “Artificial intelligence” means an engineered or machine-based system that varies in its level of autonomy and that can, for explicit or implicit objectives, infer from the input it receives how to generate outputs that can influence physical or virtual environments.
“Generative artificial intelligence” means artificial intelligence that can generate derived synthetic content, including images, videos, audio, text, and other digital content.
“Clinic” has the same meaning as defined in Section 1200.
“Health care provider” means a person licensed or certified pursuant to Division 2 (commencing with Section 500) of the Business and Professions Code.
“Health facility” has the same meaning as defined in Section 1250.

“Office of a group practice” means an office or offices in which two or more physicians are legally organized as a partnership, professional corporation, or not-for-profit corporation licensed according to subdivision (a) of Section 1204.
“Patient clinical information” means information relating to the health status of a patient.
“Physician’s office” means an office of a physician in solo practice.

obligations.summary: Health facilities, clinics, physician's offices and offices of group practices using generative AI for patient clinical communications must include a disclaimer that the communication was generated by generative AI. Placement: prominent at the beginning for letters, emails and similar messages; displayed throughout continuous online and video interactions; given verbally at the start and end of audio communications.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies where the facility, clinic, physician's office or group practice uses generative AI to generate written or verbal patient communications pertaining to patient clinical information. Does not apply where the communication is read and reviewed by a human licensed or certified health care provider (subdivision (b)).

evidence.quote: A disclaimer that indicates to the patient that the communication was generated by generative artificial intelligence.

obligations.summary: The same entities must include clear instructions describing how a patient may contact a human health care provider, employee of the health facility, clinic, physician's office or office of a group provider, or other appropriate person.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies where the facility, clinic, physician's office or group practice uses generative AI to generate written or verbal patient communications pertaining to patient clinical information.
